caption: The video captures a night scene over a calm, dark body of water. A low band of illuminated shoreline lights and a thin central tower stretch across the middle, with a vegetation silhouette anchoring the right edge. Suspended above the skyline, a roughly horizontal row of six expanded firework bursts, a mix of white and orange, hangs at a fixed height as the excerpt opens. The camera and background stay at stable screen positions, so the visible motion belongs to the fireworks rather than to any pan or zoom. Over the clip the bursts hold their altitude while losing brightness, their spherical shells spreading and dimming, the leftmost rising slightly as the row flattens. Thin vertical streaks beneath several bursts, connecting them toward the horizon, are faint at first and become visible, persisting through later frames. On the left a searchlight beam shifts, rising from a faint diagonal line into a brighter, more vertical blue column. The shoreline lights and tower remain lit, while the water mirrors the skyline, the beam, and the bursts as elongated, shimmering reflections that ripple. The row of bursts keeps its loose horizontal spread throughout, still present and still fading as the clip ends.
relations: Fireworks bursts hold altitude while expanding and dimming, the leftmost rising slightly as the row flattens.
Thin vertical streaks emerge beneath the bursts, connecting them toward the horizon as the fireworks fade.
A searchlight beam on the left shifts from a faint diagonal into a brighter vertical blue column.
The water mirrors the skyline, beam, and fading bursts as elongated, rippling reflections.
